title: Harden transaction idempotency and prepare bulk-sync endpoint
acceptance_criteria: client_uuid uniqueness enforced at DB level with unique index
Duplicate client_uuid returns existing transaction with 200 (not error)
Race condition on concurrent same-uuid requests handled (no double insert)
POST /api/v1/transactions/bulk-sync endpoint prepared accepting array of transactions
Bulk-sync processes each transaction idempotently (skips existing client_uuids)
Schema already supports bulk sync via client_uuid
completion_summary: Unique idx verified in DB; duplicate-key race replay (findExisting+retry) no double insert; bulk-sync endpoint returns created/skipped/failed; 3/3 smoke x3
